Job Description: Sr GenAI Engineer

Expertise in Azure, RAG, Agentic AI, Context Management, RLHF, Image Indexing

Role Overview

Sr. GenAI Engineer GenAI will design and implement advanced Generative AI solutions leveraging Azure resources. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, context management, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and image indexing. This role requires a proactive approach in guiding initiatives within the team and providing technical direction to drive innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Architect and deliver GenAI solutions using Azure cloud services, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
Design and implement RAG pipelines, agentic AI frameworks, and robust context management strategies to optimise AI outcomes.
Apply RLHF methodologies to improve AI model accuracy and user experience.
Develop and integrate image indexing systems to enhance data retrieval and visual analytics capabilities.
Proactively identify opportunities and guide technical initiatives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
Implement GenAI solutions leveraging Azure cloud services, with a focus on executing established initiatives to ensure scalability, security, and performance.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers and developers, ensuring best practices and high-quality deliverables.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Extensive experience with Azure cloud resources and services, including AI and data platforms.
Strong proficiency in RAG, agentic AI, and context management techniques.
Hands-on expertise in RLHF and image indexing technologies.
Track record of proactively guiding technical teams and initiatives.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Attributes

Experience in developing and deploying GenAI solutions in enterprise environments.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
